title: To the Road of Ribbon — FRequency, 1K for Linux
author: FRequency, the Debian project, busybox, PRISM
notes: Main 2009, 1K intro: a raymarched tunnel and its ribbon in one GLSL fragment shader. The intro runs as it was distributed: its dropper, a shell script, unpacks the compressed ELF to /tmp and starts it (busybox's sh, tail, zcat or lzcat), on Debian lenny's libc and dynamic loader (2009). Its libGL, libGLU, libSDL and libasound are made in JavaScript: the OpenGL calls and the GLSL go to PRISM's gl.js (vendor/prism), drawn by WebGL2; /usr/lib/libm.so is libc6-dev's link, the name it opens with dlopen.
